gen-gf-pixelify-sans-archivo: Archivo's curves swing outward instead of curling in, and its tall lowercase gives each line a confident, editorial lift. Pixelify Sans heads it; paragraphs of Archivo would flow along comfortably.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-asap: Asap keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Pixelify Sans heads the pair with a bold, single-weight line, and pages of Asap go down smoothly, its c forms opening like gentle arcs.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Pixelify Sans is bold and expressive, with a steady line weight. The standout quality is Be Vietnam Pro itself, a sans-serif whose high mean line and far-apart curve endings keep every word open.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-epilogue: Pixelify Sans brings bold, expressive letters with an unvarying line. Epilogue, a curvy sans with stubby ascender tips and a wire-like skeleton, would carry paragraphs with a loose, unclamped, contemporary ease.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans opens its s curves wide at both ends, with no stroke contrast at all and a larger-than-usual x-height. Pixelify Sans leads; paragraphs below it move along smoothly.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-merriweather-san: Pixelify Sans is bold and expressive, with no brush-like swell. It delivers the loud statement, while Merriweather Sans makes words look large and sturdy with an e that opens clearly to the right.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-public-sans: Public Sans is a hefty-bodied sans with broad, open counters that keep each curve unpinched. And across paragraphs, it feels trustworthy, leaving Pixelify Sans to supply the bold, expressive heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-ranade: Pixelify Sans holds every stroke to one thickness, like a drawn cable, and sounds bold and expressive. Ranade, with slight weight shifts and widely spaced letters, loosens things up where the heading stays rigid.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-supreme: Chunky and unfussy: Pixelify Sans has no hairlines anywhere, while Supreme sets a thick, heavy strip of sans-serif text that stays open. Pixelify Sans earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-general-sans: Bold type, smooth text: Pixelify Sans meets General Sans. Pixelify Sans earns its keep large and short, while General Sans, with steady pressure and a smooth path around each bend, fills the lines below.
